title: Fixed Screw Roof Prop
description: One original complete fixed axial mine roof-prop appearance: a broad square ground plate carries a real hollow lower tube, an annular adjustment collar with two short fixed handles, a partly enclosed upper spindle with one continuous six-turn raised thread, and a broad flat head plate. The assembled spindle occupies the lower tube and collar bore; no unobstructed through-channel is claimed. Newly authored whole vertical support, not an old press screw extracted or a curved arch/diagonal timber shore resized. No roof host is included. Static visual only: no real adjustment, operating instructions, certified thread engagement, load capacity, stability, underground installation, roof support or safety performance.
